query: I just spent the morning baking lemon blueberry scones, they turned out so flaky and sweet I even dropped a small box off for my next door neighbor when I walked my dog earlier. My little terrier was being so goofy on the walk, he stopped every two steps to sniff at every dandelion he saw, he even tried to chase a butterfly that flitted right past his nose. Oh right, the delivery person dropped off the wrong pair of gardening gloves for me last week, I had to drop them off at the post office to send back this afternoon. Anyway, I need to modify my pending order #W5061109, please change item 3694871183 to item 8555936349, and use paypal_3742148 as the payment method for the adjustment.
